study type: Retrospective cohort study for predictive model development
exposure: Multiple lacunae within the placenta (ultrasonographic finding)
Hypervascularization on Doppler flow with irregularity in the line between the bladder and uterine serosa (ultrasonographic finding)
Retroplacental myometrial thickness of < 1 mm (ultrasonographic finding)
cohort: The study included 302 patients who underwent surgery with a preliminary diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum disorders (PASD) at a tertiary center in southeast Turkey.
finding: A nomogram was developed that effectively predicts the probability of cesarean hysterectomy in PASD patients, with multiple placental lacunae and anterior placental location identified as the most significant predictors.
